title: Knee Orthoses
issue: <p>The proposed LCD proposes modifications to the coverage criteria for knee orthoses with single or double upright, adjustable flexion and extension joint, medial-lateral and rotation control, with varus/valgus adjustment for the management or treatment of ambulatory Medicare beneficiaries with pain or reduction in mobility and/or function due to medial or lateral tibiofemoral osteoarthritis.</p>
issue_change: <p>The coverage criteria for knee orthoses with varus or valgus adjustment is being finalized as proposed.</p>
